summary: Validated the 3 new features end-to-end: (1) Google OAuth session exchange (unhappy paths), (2) AniList bulk import, (3) Per-collection public share links. All 27 backend pytest tests pass (7 new). All 6 frontend surface checks pass.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}`' — a11y polish. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby in ImportAniListDialog.jsx.

action_items: (low) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to ImportAniListDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.

(low) Frontend: register-google button click capture worked but only because we routed every request — the real flow is window.location.href assignment. Consider rendering the Google button as <a href=...> instead of a button + JS for better testability and graceful no-JS fallback.
(med) server.py still ~1037 lines — continue planned router split.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/auth/google/session: ✅ rejects missing session_id with 400, bogus session_id with 401 (verified). Cookie set httpOnly samesite=lax, secure=False — fine for preview; for prod set secure=True behind HTTPS.

POST /api/import/anilist validates required fields & dedupes by external_id within the target category. Note: dedup is scoped (user_id, category_id, external_id) — if a user imports the same anime into two categories, both will have copies. That may or may not be desired; current behavior matches the request.

AniList import sets media_type total from m.get('episodes'/'chapters') which can be null for ongoing series — fine. Status mapping ANILIST_STATUS_MAP covers PLANNING/CURRENT/COMPLETED/PAUSED/DROPPED/REPEATING; unknown statuses default to 'plan'.
GET /public/u/{username}/titles?category_slug=… correctly returns 404 for unknown slugs and scopes results to that category. category_id still works (regression verified). Notes still stripped.

AuthCallback uses useRef-guarded effect and strips the hash before navigating — good. AppRoutes also has a synchronous fragment check so the loader appears immediately on hard-reload of /auth/callback#session_id=… verified visually.
Login/Register GoogleButton constructs redirect from window.location.origin (no hardcoding) and target URL shape verified: https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2Fauth%2Fcallback. ✅
Share button on Category page only renders when user.profile_public is true (verified for admin). Copies `${origin}/u/${username}/c/${category.slug}` to clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText.
PublicProfile honors the :slug param and pre-selects that category pill. Verified for /u/admin/c/kdramas in a logged-out context.
Backend google_session response sets cookie AND returns {user, token} — the frontend uses cookie only (AuthCallback ignores returned token). Mild dead weight; harmless.
ImportAniListDialog has no Description/aria-describedby → Radix warns. A11y polish only.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed titles in admin's K-Dramas/Anime/Manga and delete them in finally blocks. AniList dedup test runs against fresh ephemeral user with public AniList username 'Josh' (fallback 'Hanabi'). Existing admin titles (True Beauty, Squid Game) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features verified working end-to-end. Backend testids: POST /api/auth/google/session returns 400 (missing session_id) / 401 (bogus). POST /api/import/anilist validates username+type+category_id, scopes imports by user+category, dedupes by external_id 'al-<aniListId>', sets source='anilist'. GET /api/public/u/{username}/titles?category_slug=<slug> filters or 404s. Frontend testids: login-google, register-google, open-anilist-import, anilist-username, anilist-type, anilist-category, anilist-import-submit, share-collection-btn, public-cat-<slug>. AuthCallback shows 'Signing you in…' loader. AppRoutes synchronous hash check ensures the loader appears even on hard-reload. Admin's username is literally 'admin'.
